propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale pinned snapshot of the ticket store when close_precheck calls with fetch=False, causing it to see outdated ticket metadata like status and comments that contradict the live store.
The gate's fenced context comes from the live store but the model's show_ticket authoritative check reads a pinned snapshot, creating disagreement between the two halves of the gate.
A non-PASS verdict with no identifiable findings is synthesized into a fabricated criterion named (unspecified), making it indistinguishable from a parse failure and leaving no remediation path.
The ticket store pin resolves to a stale local mirror in the main repo instead of the live tracker repo HEAD, lagging by thousands of commits behind origin/tickets.
Two independent tickets were blocked by staleness: one saw false metadata (comments: 0, status: open), another saw no comments despite 13 existing, causing evidence search to exhaust budget.
